import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = (1 << 19) | 5;
    static int n, k, p, max_pow;
    static int[] cnt = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] f = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] tmp1 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static int[][] tmp2 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static int[][] tmp3 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static long p_pow;
    static long[][] t = new long[20][MAXN];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] inv_fact = new long[MAXN];

    static long pow_mod(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long cur = base % p;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * cur) % p;
            cur = (cur * cur) % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init() {
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= max_pow; i++)
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p;
        inv_fact[max_pow] = pow_mod(fact[max_pow], p - 2);
        for (int i = max_pow - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p;
    }

    static int get_lower(int x) {
        int res = 1;
        while (res < x) res <<= 1;
        return res;
    }

    static void transformFWT(int[] arr, int len, boolean inv) {
        long[] temp = new long[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            temp[i] = arr[i];
        }
        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        temp[i + k] -= temp[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        temp[i + k] += temp[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            arr[i] = (int) (temp[i] % p);
            if (arr[i] < 0) arr[i] += p;
        }
    }

    static void modulate(long[] x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            if (x[i] >= p_pow) x[i] -= p_pow;
        }
    }

    static void merge() {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= max_pow; i++) {
                tmp1[j][i] = 0;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= max_pow; i++) {
                t[j][i] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= max_pow; j++) {
            tmp1[cnt[j]][j] = f[j];
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            transformFWT(tmp1[j], max_pow + 1, false);
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; l + q <= 19; l++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                    t[q + l][s] += tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                t[q][s] %= p;
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            transformFWT(t[q], max_pow + 1, true);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= max_pow; j++) {
            f[j] = (int) t[cnt[j]][j];
        }
    }

    static void merge_alt() {
        long[][] tmp = new long[20][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                t[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; l + q <= 19; l++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                    t[q + l][s] += tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                t[q][s] %= p;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            transformFWT(t[i], max_pow + 1, true);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                tmp[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_pow; i++) {
            int index = cnt[i];
            tmp[index][i] = (int) t[index][i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            transformFWT(tmp[i], max_pow + 1, false);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_pow; s++) {
                tmp2[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_pow; i++) {
            int index = cnt[i];
            tmp2[index][i] = tmp[index][i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            transformFWT(tmp2[i], max_pow + 1, false);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        p_pow = (long) p * p;
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(pow_mod(k, n));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        f[0] = 1;
        max_pow = get_lower(n + 1) - 1;
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_pow; i++) {
            cnt[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_pow; i++) {
            tmp2[cnt[i]][i] = (int) inv_fact[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            transformFWT(tmp2[i], max_pow + 1, false);
        }
        int res_k = k;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                merge();
            }
            k >>= 1;
            if (k > 0) {
                merge_alt();
            }
        }
        long result = (pow_mod(res_k, n) - fact[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
